create_Benchmark: create a Benchmark instance with config paths to evaluate an agent in a Habitat environment
run_Benchmark_evaluate: run the Benchmark evaluate method to evaluate an agent over a specified number of episodes
run_Benchmark_local_evaluate: run local evaluation of an agent in the Habitat environment and return aggregated metrics
run_Benchmark_remote_evaluate: run remote evaluation of an agent via gRPC against a Habitat challenge environment
summarize_extract_scalars_from_info: summarize the _extract_scalars_from_info function that recursively extracts scalar metrics from nested info dicts
